description: This file defines the JFontChooser class, a custom Java Swing dialog for selecting fonts. It provides a user interface with font family list, size list, style checkboxes, and a sample text area to preview font selections.

classes.name: JFontChooser
classes.description: A dialog box for selecting fonts, including font family, size, and style, with a preview sample.

methods.name: showDialog(Font font)
methods.description: Displays the font chooser dialog initialized with the specified font, returns status code indicating OK or Cancel.

methods.name: showDialog()
methods.description: Displays the font chooser dialog, returns status code indicating OK or Cancel.

methods.name: setFont(Font font)
methods.description: Sets the current font selection in the dialog's UI components.

methods.name: getFont()
methods.description: Returns the selected font if the user confirmed the selection; otherwise null.

methods.name: getCurrentFont()
methods.description: Constructs and returns a Font object based on current selections (family, size, style) in the UI.
